title: pyjevsim: a Python DEVS modelling and simulation framework with HLA federate support
description: pyjevsim is a Python framework for Discrete Event System Specification (DEVS) modeling and simulation. It provides journaling, virtual- and real-time execution, and HLA federate integration through pluggable RTI backends. Version 2.2.0 adds a Portico backend, AT/SIM reference traces and application-state comparison commands for Pitch and Portico, and an experimental GORTI adapter that requires a source-installed SDK and separately built service. GORTI observations are scoped functional checks, not complete HLA Object Management or formal IEEE 1516 conformance.
